content_sections.heading: About PAU Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Punjab Agricultural University is a university in Ludhiana, Punjab. This Research Fellow post is in its Department of Plant Pathology and is provided in the scheme "Bio-efficacy evaluation of Kocide against bacterial blight of cotton Misc- 49 PC-5498". The notice is issued by the Head, Department of Plant Pathology.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prescribes the following qualifications for the post of Research Fellow. Essential: B.Sc. /B.Sc (Agriculture) with minimum OCPA 6.50/10.00 or 65% marks M.Sc. in Plant Pathology/Microbiology with minimum OCPA 6.50/10.00 or 65% marks Note 1: A candidate who does not possess a Masters degree in the relevant subject but possesses a Ph.D degree in the discipline required at Masters level shall be eligible for the post. Desirable: Preference will be given to candidates having working experience on bio control of plant diseases. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PAU Research Fellow
content_sections.text: The application is made on paper, on the form prescribed by the department. Obtain the prescribed application form from the office of the Head, Department of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana, on any working day from 9.00 am to 4.00 pm. Pay Rs 200/- for the form in the shape of a Bank draft payable at Ludhiana, in favour of Comptroller PAU, Ludhiana. Fill in the form and attach attested copies of certificates. Make sure the application reaches the office of Head, Deptt. of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana on any working day from 9.00 a.m. to 5.00 p.m., by 12 November 2026. Incomplete applications will not be entertained. Documents named in the notice: Bank draft of Rs 200/- payable at Ludhiana in favour of Comptroller PAU, Ludhiana (for the form) Attested copies of certificates, with the application Original certificates, to be brought at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The candidates should appear for the interview on 13 November 2026 at 11.30 am in the office of the Head, Department of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana. No separate intimation for the interview will be sent, so the date and time in the notice are the only call. Candidates should bring their original certificates at the time of interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Fellow vacancies are there in PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post of Research Fellow in the Department of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office of the Head, Department of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana by 12 November 2026, on any working day from 9.00 a.m. to 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the PAU Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The essential qualifications are B.Sc./B.Sc (Agriculture) and M.Sc. in Plant Pathology/Microbiology, each with a minimum OCPA of 6.50/10.00 or 65% marks. A candidate with a Ph.D in the discipline required at Masters level is eligible even without the relevant Masters degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the PAU Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The Research Fellow gets Rs.17,000/- p.m. (fixed) + 20% HRA, as provided in the scheme.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the Research Fellow pay?
faq.answer: Yes, 20% HRA is provided in the scheme in addition to the fixed pay of Rs.17,000/- p.m.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the PAU Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The prescribed form is given on payment of Rs 200/- in the shape of a Bank draft payable at Ludhiana in favour of Comptroller PAU, Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the PAU Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Obtain the prescribed form from the office of the Head, Department of Plant Pathology on any working day from 9.00 am to 4.00 pm, and submit it with attested copies of certificates so that it reaches that office by 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview for the PAU Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The interview is on 13 November 2026 at 11.30 am in the office of the Head, Department of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana; no separate intimation will be sent.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the PAU Research Fellow appointment?
faq.answer: The post is for a period of six months or till the termination of the scheme, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
